allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Life as the sole sale item in the clearance corner of Eben's Bikes can get lonely. So Red, a unicycle, dreams up a clown owner and his own juggling act that steals the show. But all too soon, the applause turns into the sound of rainfall, as reality rushes back. Red must resign himself to sitting in the corner and await his fate.

facts.title: Red's Dream

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: When the imagined roar of circus applause dissolves into the sound of falling rain, what remains for a forgotten unicycle waiting out his fate?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Stuck in the clearance corner of Eben's Bikes, a lonely unicycle named Red passes the quiet hours by imagining a grand circus act alongside a clown owner, hoping to escape his forgotten corner.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Poignant, quiet, and reflective. An easy four-minute watch with moderate emotional resonance, suitable for solitary or family viewing.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Directed by John Lasseter, this dialogue-free four-minute animated short balances whimsical circus spectacle with a surprisingly poignant meditation on longing and isolation.
